# LoopForge

> LoopForge is an open-source native macOS control plane for autonomous coding
> agents. It supervises official Codex, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local Ollama
> models through evidence-gated single loops, dependency-aware multi-agent
> graphs, and adaptive long-running watchers.

LoopForge is designed for software builds, code repair, performance work,
experiments, complex multi-module projects, batch processing, monitoring, and
other tasks that can be delegated to a coding agent. It preserves durable
checkpoints, counts only successful active Sub Agent work, audits real commands
and artifacts, and produces a self-contained HTML delivery report.

## Core workflows

- Single Loop: iterative execution and evidence-based review for one outcome.
- Auto Graph: dependency-aware agent loops with safe Git worktree parallelism.
- Continuum Watcher: deterministic local automation with bounded telemetry and
  intelligent wake conditions.

## Important facts

- Platform: Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later.
- License: Apache License 2.0.
- Models: official Codex, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or opt-in local Ollama models.
- Privacy: API keys are stored in macOS Keychain; model weights are not bundled.
- Distribution: the v1.0 community build is ad-hoc signed, not notarized.
- Independence: LoopForge is not an official OpenAI or Ollama product.
